content: do we already know which Rust version is going to be our next MSRV? I would like to know which one I need to target for the field projection work

No, I am not aware of Debian announcing anything yet, but I have just pinged in case they know something.

I would say it is best to assume 1.102 may be the one they end up picking, which will become the nightly version next Thursday. So it is probably best to land anything we may want in the next few weeks.
